content.text: Vocabulário e frases essenciais para se locomover usando diferentes meios de transporte.
Where is the parking lot, please?
Onde fica o estacionamento, por favor?
Where can I park my car?
Where can I rent a car?
I would like to rent a car for... days.
Eu gostaria de alugar um carro por... dias.
Where can I find a garage to repair my car?
Onde posso encontrar uma oficina para consertar meu carro?
I'll need to take out extra car insurance.
Vou precisar contratar um seguro de carro adicional.
Where is the bus station, please?
Onde fica a rodoviária / estação de ônibus, por favor?
When does the bus leave for...?
How much is a ticket to...?
What time will the train to... leave?
A que horas o trem para... vai sair?
Frases e palavras para não se perder e chegar ao seu destino.
Excuse me, how do I get to [nome do lugar]?
I'm looking for [nome do lugar]. Can you help me?
Pedindo por um ponto de referência
Is there a [ponto de referência] nearby?
So I need to turn left here, right?
Thank you for your help! I really appreciate it.
Complete os espaços com as palavras do quadro.
of the road. (Vá até o final da rua.)
the crossroads. (Vire à direita no cruzamento.)
the bridge. (Passe por cima da ponte.)
the bridge. (Passe por baixo da ponte.)
Ouça o áudio, traduza as frases e depois crie suas próprias frases com base no que aprendeu.
I’m planning my trip back to Thailand for the mid-term break.
Not really. I must do a lot of traveling to get back to my home.
Really? Why? How will you get home and how long will it take?
It will take more than 24 hours because I have to use many different types of transport.
Will your family meet you at the airport in Thailand?
No. I must take a bus from the airport to my home. The bus is very uncomfortable.
That does not sound nice. How will you get to London Heathrow airport?
I think it will be cheaper to use the coach, but I have a lot of luggage.
That’s ok. Usually you can pay extra to take more luggage.
Really? That’s good. Do you know where the bus station is from here?
Yes, you can walk there. It will only take you 5 minutes.
Should I buy a ticket before traveling?
Buy your ticket online if you can. It is always cheaper online.
I want to travel directly to London. Do they have direct buses to the airport?
Perfect! I will take the bus. I was thinking about a taxi, but it’s expensive.
Tuesday morning. I need to leave really early as I must check in three hours before.
Would you like to take some of my delicious homemade cake for your family?
Thanks, Lucy. But I don’t think I can. The customs officer is usually really strict.
I understand. Have a safe journey and see you when you get back.
Ouça cada áudio várias vezes, lendo junto e depois sem ler, até se familiarizar com a pronúncia e o ritmo.
Do you want to go to the gym later?
Oh, no, I can't. I'm really tired.
No, I can't. I have a bad back.
You should go swimming swimming is really good for your back.
I can't go swimming, I have a cold.
Oh, no. Well, you should have a massage.
I can't, I don't have any money.
Do you want to go for a walk on Sunday?
Don't tell me - you have a bad foot.
No, I can't go for a walk because I'm going shopping.
But you don't have any money.
